units.source_text: “近来许多人家里，灶台也罢，花瓶、井口也罢，都落满了灰尘，脏着哪。

en.t: Recently, in many homes, whether it is the stove, the flower vase, or the well, everything is covered with dust and left dirty.

units.source_text: 因此卖花人看了，越发觉得可怜。

en.t: So when a flower seller sees it, it seems all the more pitiful.

units.source_text: 可是到府上来，我就放心，我真高兴啊。”

en.t: But when I come to your house, I feel at ease, and I am truly happy.
